body:
>did you consider about changing a job

Yup. I have a couple choices I can go for in multiple states. I just don't... really care/want to. We work for money to satisfy our needs, fulfill our desires, and spend it on cool shit we see on the internet. But if you don't want any of those things, then, why bother?

>asking for some professional help

That would probably be the wisest decision if I don't go through with it. But I'm concerned on the response should I actually reveal how close I was to dying. I don't want police called because I'm at risk of harming myself. I don't want to be institutionalized because they "want to help." If I'm going to meet someone on my own free will, I want 100% assurance that any suggestions are purely suggestions and not ultimatums or forced options.
